title: [Improvements] Secondary graphs (use same scales if same units on the same graph) and replace Activity by -BGI
symptom: The issue proposes two improvements for secondary graphs: 1) When several curves with same units are in the same subgraph, calculate scale with all values to allow direct comparison. 2) Replace Insulin Activity with Blood Glucose Impact (-BGI) for secondary graphs, as -BGI is better for analyzing insulin impact on BG variations.
evidence_quote: When several curves with "same units" are in the same subGraph, it could be nice to calculate scale with all values and not separatly
